evidence_direction_note: V3-EXQ-723a REE-NATIVE J-LENS DISCRIMINATIVE-COMPACTNESS DIAGNOSTIC (Experiment A of SD-064; SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-723). experiment_purpose=diagnostic, EXCLUDED from governance scoring; claim_ids=[] (SD-064 global-workspace + MECH-191 signal-legibility CONTEXT only). Redesign fixing V3-EXQ-723's NON-DISCRIMINATIVE gates (per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-723_2026-07-09): 723's jspace_activity_fraction<0.10 (passed 350x under ceiling) and predictive_retention>=0.80 (~1.0 by construction) were trivially satisfiable by any weak linear ridge map. FIX 1 -- discriminative compactness via matched-null baselines: a CONCENTRATION CURVE (frac of latent dims, top-influence-first, to recover 90% of above-chance balanced accuracy) vs the SAME curve under RANDOM dim orderings (concentration_ratio = frac_top/frac_random; LOAD-BEARING, ~1 for a diffuse map so a weak map does not trivially pass), plus a matched-rank RANDOM-SUBSPACE activity contrast (f_J < random same-rank p5). FIX 2 -- GATE (not just report) the plan's positive-mode contrasts: reactive-bypass (H1-vs-H5 concentration divergence -- integrative H5 tighter than reactive H1) and broadcast-alignment (per-tick J-space occupancy vs MECH-287/SD-037 broadcast proxy, vs a permutation null; withheld to *_broadcast_unverified when the proxy does not vary). FIX 3 -- committed-action-balanced eval: restrict to EFFECTIVE classes (>= 25 train / >= 8 test), require >= 3 effective classes (guards 723 seed-43 near-binary degeneracy), class-balanced weighted ridge, longer P2 (9000 ticks). Same substrate as 723 (V3-EXQ-714 ARM_ON, all-ON), NO new mechanism. Self-route (HYPOTHESIS, NOT a verdict): compact core (above-null + discriminative concentration + activity + reactive-bypass) + broadcast-aligned -> compact_action_coupled_subspace_present (raises SD-064 prior; GREENLIGHTS the SD-027 V3 gate retrofit unlocking Experiment B); broadcast unassessable -> compact_subspace_present_broadcast_unverified (does NOT greenlight); broadcast not aligned -> compact_but_not_broadcast_reportable; predictable-but-diffuse -> no_compact_workspace_diffuse; under-sampled / no signal / degenerate control -> substrate_not_ready_requeue. interpretation_label=no_compact_workspace_diffuse; readiness_met=True. PROMOTES / DEMOTES NOTHING; route to /failure-autopsy for adjudication. Design: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/global_workspace_jlens_plan.md section 2.

interpretation_grid.compact_action_coupled_subspace_present: above-null predictive signal AND discriminative concentration (frac_dims_90_top / frac_dims_90_random < ratio ceil AND frac_top < abs ceil -- the LOAD-BEARING gate) AND reactive-bypass (H5 tighter than H1) AND broadcast-alignment (J-space occupancy tracks the broadcast substrate), each on a majority of seeds. The matched-rank random-subspace activity contrast (f_J vs random p5) is REPORTED as corroboration but does not gate. REE has a COMPACT, action-coupled, reportable workspace -- the J-space analogue. HYPOTHESIS (not a verdict): raises the SD-064 prior and GREENLIGHTS the SD-027 V3 boundary-gate retrofit that unlocks Experiment B. Route to /failure-autopsy.
interpretation_grid.compact_subspace_present_broadcast_unver: compact + activity + reactive-bypass all pass, but the broadcast (reportability) proxy did not vary enough to assess alignment. Present but reportability UNVERIFIED -- does NOT greenlight the SD-027 build on its own. Route to /failure-autopsy.
interpretation_grid.compact_but_not_broadcast_reportable: compact + activity + reactive-bypass pass, broadcast IS assessable but J-space occupancy does NOT track the broadcast substrate above null. Compact + integrative but not reportable -- GWT-incomplete; does NOT greenlight. Route to /failure-autopsy.
interpretation_grid.no_compact_workspace_diffuse: action IS predictable above null, but the action-predictive structure is DIFFUSE (concentration_ratio ~ 1: top-influence dims need ~as many dims as random ordering). HYPOTHESIS (not a verdict): evidence toward the SD-027-original pluralist / no-single-workspace reading. Route to /failure-autopsy.
interpretation_grid.substrate_not_ready_requeue: under-sampled P2 / too few train pairs / < MIN_EFFECTIVE_CLASSES effective classes / no above-null signal with margin / degenerate random-ordering control. NOT a verdict -- re-queue at a larger P2 budget / more training. Draw NO conclusion about SD-064.

evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-723a J-lens discriminative-compactness diagnostic (SD-064 Experiment A; supersedes V3-EXQ-723; diagnostic, claim_ids=[], non_contributory; PROMOTES/DEMOTES/WEIGHTS NOTHING). Adjudicated CONFOUNDED by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-723a_2026-07-10. The 723->723a redesign FIXED 723's non-discriminative gates: the concentration control is now non-degenerate (frac_dims_90_random ~0.94) and criteria_non_degenerate are all True, so the load-bearing concentration_discriminative FAIL (0/3 ready seeds; concentration_ratio ~0.80 > 0.50 ceiling) -> self-route no_compact_workspace_diffuse is a trustworthy MEASUREMENT. BUT it reads the same competence-limited all-ON substrate (V3-EXQ-714 config) that 719a/724/732 showed forages ~0 because the observation interface is unlearnable (732 = H2_observation_interface_unlearnable); 723a itself forages 0.158 res/ep (< 1.0 floor) with a weak action-predictive signal (bal_acc 0.47 vs null 0.29). A near-monostrategy incompetent policy and a genuinely-diffuse workspace are indistinguishable from this readout, so the diffuse verdict is NOT a genuine no-workspace negative and does NOT support the SD-027-original pluralist reading -- compact-vs-diffuse is UNRESOLVED. Does NOT greenlight the SD-027/MECH-254 Experiment-B access-gate build (plan sec 2/5); does NOT weaken SD-064 (stays candidate/v3_pending, evidentially UNTESTED in V3). 4th diagnostic (719a->724->732->723a) to bottom out on the V3 competence floor. Experiment A re-read RE-GATED behind the 732-localized observation-encoding competence build (implement-substrate); same-substrate 723b REFUSED (re-derive brake fired substantively; claim_ids=[] so the claim-count trigger is 0). pending_retest_after_substrate.
